title: Sr. Staff Architect
jobDescription:
As a Senior Staff Architect, you are a high-impact individual contributor responsible for designing robust and scalable solutions within a domain stream. You bring deep technical and functional expertise and partner with cross-functional teams to define and implement architecture that supports business and technical objectives. Department: Enterprise Architecture

ROLE:
Senior Staff Enterprise Solution Architect Employment Type : Full- Time Location: Hyderabad, India (HDC) This role is focused on hands-on solution design, documentation, and delivery — with increasing influence across products, platforms, and governing teams. You bring deep expertise in retail and consumer goods, partnering with cross-functional business, product, and engineering teams to define and implement architecture that is robust, scalable, and aligned to both business and technical objectives. You serve as a bridge between architecture and engineering leadership, ensuring consistency, quality, and performance of solutions. As AI reshapes how software is designed and delivered, you will play an active role in embedding AI-driven thinking into architecture practices and championing adoption across your domain. What You'll Do Solution design & documentation Design and document end-to-end solutions for key initiatives within your domain, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture standards and business needs. Project architecture leadership Lead architecture for individual projects and features, guiding engineering teams through solution execution and well-reasoned technical trade-offs. Cross-functional collaboration Partner with strategy teams, product managers, architects and engineers to translate requirements into scalable, maintainable architecture complaining to EA guidelines. Provide architectural input across multiple simultaneous initiatives. Quality, feasibility & integration alignment Ensure technical feasibility, performance, and integration alignment of solutions with adjacent systems and domains. Participate in defining, enhancing and ensuring design and code reviews to uphold architectural quality. Architecture framework & reusability Contribute to the evolution of architecture frameworks, reusable components, and reference implementations that raise the bar across the engineering organisation. Planning, estimation & technology evaluation Engage in early project planning and estimation through an architecture lens. Stay current with emerging technologies and help evaluate their applicability within your domain. AI ADOPTION Identify and drive opportunities to integrate AI and ML capabilities into enterprise domain solutions to enhance business value and operational efficiency. Serve as a strategic advocate for responsible, ethical, and compliant AI adoption across the domain architecture landscape. Lead the execution and advancement of enterprise architecture strategies in alignment with the vision and direction established by Principal Architects. ENTERPRISE ARCHITECTURE COLLABORATION Hands-on solution design and delivery within a domain stream. Operationalises enterprise guidance into project-level architecture. Alignment with Principal & Sr Principal Architects: Engage regularly with Principal and Senior Principal Architects to ensure domain-level solutions are grounded in enterprise architecture strategy. Consume and operationalise enterprise standards, patterns, and guardrails into project-level designs, and surface domain-specific insights that inform broader strategic decisions. Cross-domain architecture reviews: Participate in architecture review boards and cross-domain design forums facilitated by Principal Architects. Represent your domain's perspective, highlight integration touch-points, and collaborate on solutions that span multiple domain streams. Feedback loop & pattern sharing: Maintain a continuous feedback loop with the EA team — sharing reusable patterns, lessons learned, and implementation experiences from domain delivery that can be elevated into enterprise-wide frameworks and reference architectures. Strategic roadmap contribution: Contribute domain-level input to enterprise technology roadmaps and strategic initiatives led by Senior Principal Architects. Help bridge the gap between long-term architectural vision and near-term delivery realities within your domain. Saa S Vendor Product Evaluations: Collaborate with Principal Architects and product stakeholders to ensure recommended Saa S choices are grounded in both domain delivery needs and long-term enterprise architecture direction. Who You Are Seasoned technologist with strong architectural thinking and a solid background in hands-on software or platform engineering. Deep understanding of at least one architectural Product to Market domain stream, with the ability to contribute meaningfully to cross-domain conversations. Able to manage and prioritise multiple concurrent initiatives, providing architectural support from planning through to delivery. Experienced engaging with senior architecture leadership — comfortable consuming enterprise strategy from Principal and Senior Principal Architects and translating it into grounded, deliverable domain solutions. Skilled at producing technical documentation and architecture artifacts that clearly communicate design intent to both Strategy, Business, Engineering and non-technical stakeholders. Collaborative and delivery-oriented, with a track record of working closely with cross-functional product and engineering teams. Strong attention to detail with a passion for quality, performance, and reusability; capable of independently solving architectural challenges and escalating when cross-functional coordination is needed. Saa S Vendor Evaluations
- Translate Saa S market evaluations into well-reasoned architectural recommendations with clear trade-off analysis : Cost & TCO over time, Scalability & performance, Integration complexity, Vendor maturity & stability, Enterprise standards alignment, Po C / reference validation Eager to learn, grow, and actively contribute in defining and adopting enterprise architectural practices and patterns across the organisation. Comfortable navigating the nuances of responsible AI adoption — including data privacy, model governance, and balancing innovation with risk. A trusted voice within the EA community — able to represent domain interests in broader architecture forums while remaining open to enterprise-wide direction and standards. Curious about AI and its practical application in enterprise architecture — whether through predictive analytics, generative AI, ML-powered features, or AI-augmented engineering workflows. We’re a company that’s been synonymous with equality and inclusivity since our founding. The first of our industry to translate our commitment to sustainability into true accountability. Made stronger by our global team’s unique personalities, passions and pride, we set out every day to make the world a bit bolder and a bit brighter.

title: Manager, IT Audit
jobDescription:
The Internal Audit (“IA”) Department is seeking an experienced IT SOX Manager to join the Gap Inc. This role will be based in Hyderabad (Gap HDC) and will partner closely with global Internal Audit, IT, and business stakeholders to ensure effective design, implementation, and testing of IT General Controls (ITGCs), automated controls, and key reports. The ideal candidate will bring strong technical expertise, leadership capability, and a proactive and innovation mindset to drive compliance excellence and continuous improvement. What You'll Do Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Lead end-to-end execution of the IT SOX program, including annual planning, scoping, risk assessment, and reporting across global in-scope systems. • Oversee the design and operating effectiveness testing of ITGCs (Access, Change Management, IT Operations) and ITACs, ensuring high-quality and consistent execution. • Ensure alignment with SOX requirements, PCAOB standards, and internal audit methodologies, maintaining audit readiness at all times. • Partner with global IT teams, business stakeholders, co-source partners, and external auditors to coordinate and drive SOX activities across regions. • Serve as the primary point of contact for IT SOX within Gap HDC, providing guidance on control requirements, risks, and remediation strategies. • Lead and facilitate walkthroughs, risk assessments, and control design discussions, ensuring accurate and complete documentation (e.g., RCMs, narratives, flowcharts). • Evaluate the overall IT control environment, identify systemic gaps, and provide strategic, risk-based remediation recommendations. • Oversee deficiency evaluation and remediation, including impact assessment, root cause analysis, and validation of issue closure. • Assess the SOX impact of system implementations, upgrades, and transformations, ensuring controls are appropriately designed and implemented. • Coordinate with external auditors to support reliance on IT controls, including timely delivery of documentation and resolution of audit queries. • Develop and deliver status reporting, dashboards, and executive-level insights on IT SOX compliance, risks, and trends. • Drive standardization and consistency in control documentation, testing approaches, and evidence requirements across teams. • Identify and implement opportunities to enhance efficiency, including automation, data analytics, and control rationalization. • Promote best practices in IT risk management, governance, and compliance across the organization. • Lead, coach, and develop a team of IT SOX professionals, providing clear direction, performance feedback, and growth opportunities. • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement within the team and across stakeholder groups. Who You Are Who You Are: Required: Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field. 8+ years of experience in IT audit, IT SOX, or IT risk management At least 3–5 years in a leadership or managerial role CISA, CISSP certification highly preferred Strong knowledge of testing IT General Controls, IT application controls, interfaces, SOC reports. Strong working knowledge of ERP systems (Oracle), cloud environments (Azure) and microservices architecture is highly preferred Experience working with external auditors (Big 4 preferred) Proactive individual who can work independently and has strong project management, communication skills Nice to Have: Experience with GRC tools (e.g., Service Now GRC, Audit Board) Experience in retail or consumer-facing industries At Gap Inc., we’re more than the clothes we make. title: Sr Software Engineer
jobDescription: In this role, you will design highly scalable and high performing technology solutions in an Agile work environment and produce and deliver code and/or test cases using your knowledge of software development and Agile practice. You will collaborate closely with business support teams, product managers, security and architecture to assist in resolving critical production issues to help simplify and improve business processes through the latest in technology and automation. You are a technical expert that will lead through the requirements gathering, design, development, deployment, and support phases of a product. You are proficient in at least one core programming languages or packages. What You'll Do Define technical specifications and development requirements that result in high performing technologies that are also domain specific. Develop and enhance product and/or applications with limited direction to solve business problems of medium complexity by keeping customer experience at the forefront. Adopt and model a Dev Ops mindset by applying automation, continuous integration and continuous delivery in everything we do. Foster innovation by applying best practices and learning from emerging technologies and through collaboration with cross functional stakeholders. Serve as application expert in support of domain areas. Communicate difficult concepts, providing technical and professional interpretations and recommendations. Advise and mentor junior team members and enable collaboration to help teams achieve their best. Who You Are Software Development experience and understanding of security, secure coding/testing and data structures and aware of industry and competitor practices. Comprehensive knowledge of software development, practice, concepts and technology. Proficiency with various software languages and platforms such as Java, Oracle, Azure etc. Experience with related technology stack and platforms.
